THE EXPLORER’S FIELD GUIDE

Into the Deep

The Search for ROOT’s Cousin

Explore connected tunnels and climb glowing rope ladders. Your map reveals rooms as you visit. The glowing rock archway marks the exit: press E nearby to descend.

J attacks in the direction you face. The spear is melee. Rocks (8), dart guns (15) and sap bombs (3) equip on pickup; use 1–4 to select any weapon you have. Bombs explode on impact and can clear a dangerous cluster. Your spear strengthens every four levels; deeper weapon pickups also carry higher Mk ratings. Ordinary enemies take roughly 2–4 current-tier spear hits; tougher foes take 5–7.

Starting rewards: snakes 25 · bats 40 · rats 60 · spiders 100. Rewards increase with depth; gold-marked veterans are tougher and worth more. Chests hold common or rare treasure. Glowing fungi restore a little health. Stickolas recovers fully at each exit. Donald’s torch never runs out. Collect a golden Sunspore to reveal the entire screen for 12 seconds; its last two seconds fade back to torchlight. The countdown pauses when the game is paused. Each floor has a Sunspore, ammunition, and healing supplies along the route to the exit.

On mobile, hold the left arrows to move or climb. You can move, jump and attack together with different fingers. The Weapon button cycles available weapons for Stickolas. Enter descends when you stand at the cave entrance. Portrait and landscape both work; landscape gives a wider view. Stickolas always defends, and Donald follows with the torch. Its warm halo fades into complete darkness; unexplored passages, enemies and treasure become visible as you approach. Donald is protected while Stickolas fights. If Stickolas falls, the expedition ends. Esc pauses. Progress saves on this browser.
